# The Q3_011 packaging fixture

A tiny Quake III map with one shader script, five textures, two MD3 models and a
sound, all of it **generated by `gen_fixture.py`** in this directory. Nothing
here is copied or derived from any game, map or asset pack; it is dedicated to
the public domain under CC0 1.0 (`content/LICENSE-apq3011.txt`), so it may be
committed, packaged and redistributed by the tests that read it.

| path | what |
| --- | --- |
| `gen_fixture.py` | the generator; `python3 gen_fixture.py <dir>` writes `assets/`, `src/` and a stored PK3 |
| `content/` | the generator's `assets/` tree: what a PK3 of the user's own content holds |
| `maps/q3011_room.map` | the map source |
| `maps/q3011_room.bsp` | that source compiled by the real Q3Map2 2.5.17n-git-68ecbed, `-meta`, `-vis -saveprt -fast`, `-light -fast`, one thread, against `content/` as a PK3 in `baseq3`: exit 0/0/0, no warning |

The map is built to make the compile set and the runtime set differ in both
directions, because that difference is what the package layer is for:

- `models/apq3011/crate.md3` is a `misc_model`: the compiler bakes it into the
  BSP, so an engine never opens the `.md3` — and does draw its skin,
  `models/apq3011/crate`, which the map source never names;
- `models/apq3011/beacon.md3` is a `func_static`'s `model2`: the compiler never
  opens it, and an engine does;
- `textures/apq3011/glow_editor.tga` is the `glow` shader's `qer_editorimage`
  (compile) and `glow_stage.tga` is its stage image (runtime);
- `sound/apq3011/hum.wav` is a `target_speaker`'s `noise`: runtime only.
